notes.title: New game, Ødeborg!
notes.notes: [p]Hello whoever can see this![/p][p][/p][p]I've been working on a new game for this year with a few other people! It's called Ødeborg, and it's a bit different from the previous games I have released on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]You take the role of a Danish soldier in 1785, a dark time for the Kingdom of Denmark-Norway. Nobody has received any word from the king for three days, and all soldiers sent to investigate have not returned. You, a general of the Danish army, are sent with a large group to investigate, in an attempt to figure out what is going on. But as you travel through the night, there's... something, that attacks you. Your horse runs away in the confusion, saving you from the fate that meets your men. Alone, you must go to the castle alone to find the king, and to figure out what happened.[/p][p][/p][p]This is a puzzle exploration game where you must navigate the castle, solve puzzles, and defeat any enemies you might face. But be careful, your gun only holds one bullet at a time, so use them sparingly...[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to check it out, you can do so here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860780/deborg/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]It releases on the 4th of August![/p]
